x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
KIMI ANTONELLI 🇮🇹

From 19th on the grid to the top step of the podium at MONZA.

The first Italian to win the Italian Grand Prix since 1966.

At his home race. On an engine penalty. Absolutely unreal. #F1 #ItalianGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Antonelli now leads the 2026 championship by 66 points after his Monza miracle.

7 wins. 6 poles. Started 19th. Won anyway.

The youngest title favourite in F1 just grew up all at once. #F1 #ItalianGP

stories.title: Charles Leclerc — Crash and Red Flag

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Ferrari's worst nightmare at their home race.

Leclerc lost the rear through Parabolica on Lap 2, hit the barriers hard, and brought out the red flag.

He walked away — but later reported vision problems after the impact. Scary stuff. #F1 #ItalianGP

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Charles Leclerc underwent further medical checks after revealing he suffered vision problems following his Lap 2 crash at Monza.

He walked to the medical car unaided — but this is a serious development.

Sending respect to Charles. #F1 #CharlesLeclerc
